name: Gilead Sciences
tagline: Advancing Innovative Medicines for Life-Threatening Diseases
hero_kpi_rationale: Principal indicateur de la performance financière de l'entreprise, reflétant la croissance de 2% et la demande accrue pour les thérapies VIH et les produits hépatiques

stories_kpis.signal: Traitement COVID-19 en repli structurel avec la baisse des hospitalisations, -49 % sur l'exercice.
stories_kpis.explanation: Chiffre d'affaires mondial du Veklury (remdesivir), antiviral COVID-19. Serie 2021-2025 verbatim 10-K, en forte decrue depuis le pic pandemique.

stories_kpis.signal: Therapie oncologique en croissance continue, fer de lance de la diversification hors VIH.
stories_kpis.explanation: Chiffre d'affaires mondial du Trodelvy (sacituzumab govitecan), anticorps conjugue en oncologie. Serie 2021-2025 verbatim 10-K.

stories_kpis.signal: Coeur de revenus du groupe, franchise VIH en hausse reguliere portee par Biktarvy et Descovy.
stories_kpis.explanation: Chiffre d'affaires mondial de la franchise VIH (Biktarvy, Descovy, Genvoya, etc.). Serie 2021-2025 verbatim 10-K, principal moteur de Gilead.

stories_kpis.signal: Pole oncologie (Trodelvy plus therapies cellulaires) multiplie par 2,5 depuis 2021, leger repli en 2025.
stories_kpis.explanation: Chiffre d'affaires oncologie total (Trodelvy plus therapies cellulaires Yescarta et Tecartus). Serie 2021-2025 verbatim 10-K.

ai_positioning.summary: Gilead mentionne explicitement l'adoption et la mise à l'échelle de l'intelligence artificielle comme priorité stratégique dans son rapport 10-K 2025. L'IA figure parmi les cinq priorités stratégiques visant à transformer les opérations de l'entreprise.
evidence: Strategic priorities refreshed in late 2025 include: adopt and scale artificial intelligence to transform how we work

risks.title: Increased competition in cell therapies
risks.score_rationale: The company faces ongoing competitive headwinds in cell therapy products (Tecartus, Yescarta), with expected sales decreases in 2026 due to competitive pressures (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Cell therapy product sales expected to decrease due to competitive headwinds in 2026

risks.title: Regulatory changes affecting drug pricing
risks.score_rationale: Various policy-related developments in the U.S. are expected to offset product sales growth in 2026, with significant impact on pricing and market access (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: U.S. policy-related developments are expected to negatively impact 2026 revenues

risks.title: Dependence on key products
risks.score_rationale: HIV product sales represent significant revenue concentration (20.8 billion in 2025), creating vulnerability to competitive and regulatory changes (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: High revenue concentration in HIV products, particularly Biktarvy and Descovy

risks.title: Clinical trial risks and delays
risks.score_rationale: Recent clinical trial setbacks include FDA clinical hold on GS-1720/GS-4182 trials and discontinuation of STAR-221 study in gastric cancer (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Clinical trial failures and FDA holds on investigational compounds

risks.title: Patent litigation and LOE risk
risks.score_rationale: Biktarvy patent settlements have extended LOE to April 2036, but continued patent challenges remain in the pipeline (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Ongoing patent litigation risks related to key products

risks.title: Foreign exchange volatility
risks.score_rationale: International operations expose Gilead to currency fluctuations affecting reported revenues and financial results (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Foreign exchange exposure across 35+ countries of operation

risks.title: Pipeline execution and product development
risks.score_rationale: Company targets 10+ transformative therapies by 2030; failure to execute clinical programs and secure approvals threatens long-term growth (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Success depends on advancing 50+ clinical-stage programs to market

governance.voting_structure: Une seule classe d'actions ordinaires, 1 vote par action.

company_description: Gilead Sciences, Inc., a biopharmaceutical company, discovers, develops, and commercializes medicines in the areas of unmet medical need in the United States, Europe, and internationally. The company provides Biktarvy, Descovy, Genvoya, Odefsey, Sunlenca, Symtuza, and YeztugoFor the treatment of HIV-1 infection in patients. It also provides Epclusa, Livdelzi, and Vemlidy to treat chronic hepatitis C virus, primary biliary cholangitis, and chronic hepatitis B virus; Tecartus, a T-cell therapy for the treatment of adult patients; Trodelvy, an injection for intravenous use; and Yescarta, a suspension for intravenous infusion, is a CAR T-cell therapy for the treatment of adult patients. Further, it provides AmBisome, for the treatment of serious invasive fungal infections; and Veklury for the treatment of COVID-19. Additionally, the company engages in the development of various immunotherapies for patients with cancer and other incurable diseases. The company has collaboration agreements with Shenzhen Pregene Biopharma Co., Ltd.; Abingworth; Arcus Biosciences, Inc.; Merck Sharp & Dohme Corp.; Janssen Sciences Ireland Unlimited Company; Japan Tobacco, Inc.; Everest Medicines; Merck & Co
